document.business_rules:
1. Start with credit off, no payment method selected, no authorization. Apply account credit is disabled when creditCents is zero. If on, applied credit = min(creditCents,dueCents); otherwise zero. Remaining = dueCents minus applied credit. Use integer cents and fixed USD formatting with two decimals and comma thousands separators.
2. Payment methods are single selection, enabled only when available and remaining is positive. When remaining becomes zero, clear any method selection and disable every method. A credit or method change clears authorization.
3. Settle invoice requires authorization and either remaining zero or an enabled selected method. Summary is 'Credit USD {applied} · Remaining USD {remaining}', as shown by exact public outcomes.
4. Submit emits exactly one 'settle|{entityId}|{applied integer cents}|{remaining integer cents}|{methodId}', using literal 'credit' when remaining is zero. Then lock all controls. Decision taps emit no events.
5. Same-entity replacement keeps credit on only if positive credit remains, keeps a chosen method only if still available and remaining stays positive, recomputes both amounts, and clears authorization/recorded state. A changed entityId resets credit, method, authorization, and recorded state. Replacement is silent.
6. This is an allocation request UI; payment processing, banking, taxation, and external accounting persistence are outside scope.

measurementSources.iosTypography: Independent design choice: system font, fixed 22pt semibold title, 16pt regular body at approved Large Dynamic Type; visual intent only, no computed SwiftUI font claim.
measurementSources.spacing: Independent design choice, informed by AlertToast.banner VStack leading/spacing10/cornerRadius10 and ReplyEmailListItem Column padding20. This design explicitly fixes its own 16/12/8 rhythm and 16/8 radii, rather than claiming those are upstream defaults.

obligations.clause: All supplied and computed business text is current and exact.
Native disabled/selected facts obey published business decisions.
Exact tap event intervals require demonstrated successful original native dispatch; blocked taps never prove quiet behavior.
Same-entity revalidation and changed-entity reset are distinct and callback-silent.
Typography follows sourced native or qualitative platform intent.
Full variable-length vertical content wraps, fits and preserves separation/insets.
Component opaque fills match approved suitable pixel regions; primary ink is readable.
Primary control accessibility-box height is48pt/dp; no physical OS hit-area claim.
Visible selection marks agree with native selected facts.
Panel and option corner shape follow independent annotated references.
